hooks.command:
p=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path"); case "$p" in *src/data/registry.ts|*src/data/lifecycle.ts|*src/lib/portfolio.ts) out=$(RUN_DEMO=1 node src/lib/portfolio.ts 2>&1) || { printf "%s
" "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

p=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path"); case "$p" in *.ts|*.tsx) hits=$(grep -nE "\"#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\"|\[#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\]" "$p") && { printf "raw hex in %s — use a --token from globals.css (DESIGN.md: no raw hex in components):
%s
" "$p" "$hits" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
